experiment: Real-plan end-to-end compilation and classical readout audit
caveats: STRUCTURE_ONLY cases have NOT been semantically verified.
A terminal-readout probe tests the joint classical-output distribution of an instrumented source circuit, not its full quantum channel.
Tests assume a |0...0> input and ideal operations, not arbitrary states, hardware noise, or routing.
Mutations were selected from pre-validated static-valid cases; this audit independently tests their actual compilation.
